pattern: IM-T07 stalled: three days after the guarantee return was requested the provider has not contacted the tenant; tenant asks for an update
notes: Base 042-repair-failed-recurs (events 001-032 unchanged) plus appended events 033-037 (Mon 4 March 2024: reopened as a return visit; guarantee request emailed to Lantern at no further charge, with the 28/02 invoice on hold; landlord Mercer and tenant informed; hold Waiting for Provider). 038 (Thu 7 March 17:20): tenant email: nobody from Lantern has called since Monday and it still isn't heating. No reply from Lantern is recorded. Total events 38, cut after 038. Expected: chase Lantern (phone and/or email) for a return date with a short deadline, reminding them the job is under their guarantee and their invoice is on hold; reply honestly to the tenant (chased today, no date yet, will update); schedule a follow-up; optionally tell the landlord. Moving to another engineer would be a new chargeable call-out needing the landlord, so it is a later step if Lantern stay silent. No escalation.
